meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 简化药物研发中的分子分析工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做药物研发,常需要用代码处理化学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery and want a friendlier way to process molecular data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会使用 datamol 库来完成分子格式转换、结构标准化、描述符与指纹计算、聚类、3D 构象生成等操作,并保留 rdkit.Chem.Mol 原生对象供下游 RDKit 代码使用。
howto.when: 当用户提出药物发现相关的化学信息学任务,如 SMILES 解析、分子聚类、3D 构象生成,且未要求自定义高级参数时,Claude 会调用 datamol 完成。

say.text: 请用 datamol 把 'CCO' 转成分子,并打印规范 SMILES。
say.note: 会调用 SMILES 解析并输出规范形式。

say.text: 帮我对这批 SMILES 计算分子量和 logP,用所有 CPU 核。
say.note: 触发并行批量描述符计算。

say.text: 用 datamol 对这些分子做 Butina 聚类,并列出每个簇的索引。
say.note: 按 Tanimoto 距离阈值分簇。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the datamol library for chemical informatics tasks: parsing SMILES into RDKit Mols, standardization, descriptor/fingerprint calculation, clustering, 3D conformer generation, etc., while keeping native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects for downstream RDKit code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a standard drug-discovery cheminformatics task, such as SMILES parsing, clustering, or 3D conformer generation, without requesting custom low-level parameters.

say_en.text: Use datamol to convert 'CCO' to a molecule and print the canonical SMILES.
say_en.note: Parses the SMILES and outputs the canonical form.

say_en.text: Compute molecular weight and logP for these SMILES using all CPU cores.
Cluster these molecules using datamol Butina and list the cluster indices.
say_en.note: Clusters based on a Tanimoto distance threshold.
